newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Athletics-George sets new world pole vault record.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Athletics-George sets new world pole vault record.

text.p: Australia's Emma George has broken her own world record for the women's pole vault, an Athletics Australia spokesman said on Sunday.
George set a new mark of 4.50 metres at the Victoria state track and field championships on Saturday, adding five centimetres to the previous record she set in Japan last July.
Saturday's leap was the eighth time George had set a new world mark since November, 1995.
George also holds the women's indoor pole vault record. Last December the Australian shattered by 12 centimetres the previous indoor mark of 4.28 metres held by China's Sun Caiyun.
